messages:
Jordan: Heads up — noticed the per-route latency chart flips when someone uses the console "pin version" affordance. Charts for route `payments/compute` looked fine, then suddenly +120ms after a pin.
Sophia: Huh. Do you have a link or query?
Jordan: https://console.redwood/metrics/route/payments/compute?range=1h (screenshot pasted)
Jordan: Query we use: `sum(rate(token_latency_ms_sum{route=\"payments/compute\"}[$__range]) ) by (variant)` — when pin happens, the `variant` label value changes to `pinned:v2` and previous series drops off. Looks like the dashboard treats that as a new metric instead of continuing the line so it appears as a spike.
Amit: This is a labels/affordance mismatch. Console pinning writes route_tags and a `pinned_version` label but our dashboard panels prefer `variant`. No stable label glue.
Lina: So the telemetry didn't break, the visualization just lost continuity?
Jordan: Exactly. But customers see it as sudden latency regression. We should prevent false alerts.
OpsBot: Alert: route payments/compute latency anomalous for tenant-42 at 2025-11-12T14:02Z (detected by anomaly-detector v3).
Sophia: Ops is getting paged — we can't have pin UX trigger false signals. Quick mitigation?
Amit: Two options: 1) Console emits a `variant_alias` metric when pin happens to map old->new labels, or 2) Dashboard panels use stable `route_id` label that never changes. Option 2 is quickest for reducing noise.
Henry: I can patch the dashboard templates to prefer `route_id` and fall back to `variant` in the query. Minimal change: `by (coalesce(route_id, variant))` (pseudocode).
Lina: Good. Also we should add an event metric `console.pin` with `{route_id, from_variant, to_variant}` so we can annotate graphs and suppress alerts for N minutes after a pin.
Sophia: Agree. Annotating would help SREs understand cause. Can we do both? quick query change today + pin metric next sprint.
Jordan: I'll open a PR for dashboard template tweak and add a temporary alert suppression rule for pin events (team consensus: temporary). PR: https://github.com/redwood/platform/pull/9999
Amit: I'll spec the `console.pin` metric and a telemetry migration doc — we need to backfill mapping for pins that happened in the last 48h for historical continuity.
Henry: For backfill: synthetic events bridging `variant` -> `pinned:vX` for 24-48h should be enough to smooth charts. I'll coordinate with observability.
Lina: Owners: Jordan (dashboard PR + temporary alert suppression), Amit (metric spec + backfill plan), Henry (backfill execution), Sophia (pager comms).
Jordan: I'll also add a console UX note to warn that pinning can cause short-lived telemetry label churn and that it's expected until dashboards update.
Sophia: Thanks. Please ping #incidents if we see more noisy pages. :thumbsup:
Amit: Filing spec now. TL;DR: dashboard change today, metric + backfill next sprint, console UX copy update.
OpsBot: Note: suppression rule applied to alerts for payments/compute for 10m (manual).
Jordan: Closing loop — will post PR and deployment ETA here when ready.
Sophia: Sounds good — thanks everyone.
